results.title: How to explain the ROC curve and ROC AUC score?
results.content: The ROC curve plots the True Positive rate (TPR) against the False Positive rate (FPR) at various classification thresholds. A **ROC AUC score** is a single metric to summarize the performance of a classifier across different thresholds. ROC AUC score, instead, shows how well a model can produce **relative** scores that help discriminate between positive or negative instances. * **It is a suitable evaluation metric for imbalanced data.** ROC AUC measures the model's ability to discriminate between the positive and negative classes, regardless of their relative frequencies in the dataset. * Both in training and production evaluation, ROC AUC helps provide a **more complete picture** of the model performance, giving a single metric that sums up the quality across different thresholds. To quickly calculate and visualize the ROC curve and ROC AUC score, as well as other metrics and plots to evaluate the quality of a classification model, you can use Evidently, an open-source Python library to evaluate, test and monitor ML models in production.
